name: bilingual-translator
description: Bilingual CLI translator mod for Claude Code: translates Chinese prompts to English before sending (without leaking original text into model context) and translates English answers back to Chinese using an external OpenAI-compatible model.

apiBaseUrl.title: API Base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL (e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1)

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: API key for the external translation model

model.title: Model
model.description: External model ID used for translation (does not consume Claude quota)

disableThinking.title: Disable Thinking
disableThinking.description: Send thinking={type:disabled} for faster, lower-token translation on reasoning-capable models

reasoningEffort.title: Reasoning Effort
reasoningEffort.description: Optional reasoning_effort when thinking is enabled (e.g. minimal, low, medium, high; empty to omit)

enableInputTranslate.title: Translate Input (ZH -> EN)
enableInputTranslate.description: Automatically translate Chinese prompts to English before sending to Claude

enableOutputTranslate.title: Translate Output (EN -> ZH)
enableOutputTranslate.description: Automatically translate Claude's final English response to Chinese in the UI

timeoutMs.title: Request Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for external translation API calls
